text: dsh-mv-cli 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的音乐视频放映室，在 DSH 中注册侧边栏入口和工作台面板，以画布播放与用户本地音频同步的文字、Canvas2D 或 WebGL 场景。它支持管理 MV 包、显示同步歌词、查询歌词时间轴、通过本地引擎识别歌词，并可从创意工坊安装社区包或导入已渲染视频。适合想在 DSH 中用自己的音乐欣赏或制作 MV 的用户；播放使用本地音频，LRCLIB 查询可关闭，其他功能不要求 API Key。

dsh-mv-cli adds a music video room to DeepSeek Harness Desktop. It plays canvas scenes in sync with local audio, manages MV packs and timed lyrics, and supports community packs and rendered video imports. Optional lyric lookup and local transcription help prepare captions. No API key is required.
想在 DSH 里用自己的音乐播放同步画面的 MV。
有没有能在桌面工作台显示歌词和动画的音乐播放器？
我想把本地歌曲配上 Canvas 或 WebGL 场景播放。
怎样在 DSH 里管理和切换不同的 MV 包？
I want to play visual scenes synchronized to my own music inside DSH.
Can I browse and install community music video packs from a desktop panel?
dsh-mv-cli 的功能「同步播放 MV」：在工作台面板选择 MV 包和本地音频，以画布呈现文字、Canvas2D 或 WebGL 场景，并显示同步歌词。
dsh-mv-cli 的功能「歌词辅助」：自动制作流程可按曲名等信息查询 LRCLIB 歌词时间轴，也能使用本地歌词识别引擎生成时间信息。
dsh-mv-cli 的功能「MV 创意工坊」：在面板浏览社区 MV 包并安装、管理已安装内容，也可准备发布用的文件夹。
dsh-mv-cli 的功能「视频包导入」：命令行将已渲染的视频整理为 MV 包，可指定本地音频、歌词及时间偏移；导入器不会启动渲染流程。
dsh-mv-cli 使用前须知：LRCLIB 查询默认开启，只发送曲名、歌手、专辑和时长，不上传音频；可关闭查询。见 .dsh-plugin/index.mjs:35。
我有渲染好的视频，想整理成 DSH 能播放的音乐视频包。
I want to add timed lyrics to a music video using a local transcription engine.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · dsh-mv-cli · world.execute(me); screening room：**MV 放映室** is a DeepSeek Harness Desktop plugin (`@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli`, profile entry id `dsh-mv`, current version **0.12.2**) that plays ASCII / terminal-styled, pixel 2D, WebGL2 3D and local rendered **music videos** on a `<canvas>` in the workbench. Script scenes use **your own audio** as the clock; local videos use their own media clock.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · dsh-mv-cli · world.execute(me); screening room：Supports DSH **0.2.1-rc.3 / rc.2** and **0.2.0-rc.1 / rc.2**. If an older plugin version is disabled because of a protocol mismatch, update the plugin and restart Harness.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**One-line value:** Adds an MV 放映室 sidebar for creating and playing music videos synced to your own audio or video, with lyrics and ASCII, Canvas2D, and WebGL2 scenes.

**Primary category (one of the directory's 11 categories):** Entertainment (music and media).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**Install command (npm, pinned):**
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli@0.12.2
```
The same package can be installed from **DeepSeek Harness Desktop → Plugins → Add plugin** by entering `@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli@0.12.2`.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**Compatibility:** DSH protocol `0.2.1-rc.3` / `0.2.1-rc.2` and `0.2.0-rc.1` / `0.2.0-rc.2`; Host Node.js `>=20`. WebGL scenes need Chromium Worker OffscreenCanvas and WebGL2; unsupported clients fall back to the generic renderer. Local video decoding depends on Chromium codecs.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**Configuration files:** The root `package.json` identifies the npm package and declares `dsh.bundle.patch`; `cordis.patch.yml` registers the `dsh-mv` plugin row, whose module exports `apply(ctx)` from `.dsh-plugin/index.mjs`. Each MV pack uses `mv.json`, with `mv.schema.json` for validation and editor completion. Runtime settings are managed in the DSH plugin configuration page (`canvasFontSize`, `ffmpegPath`, `lrclib`, `enginePython`, `uvPath`, `hfEndpoint`, `httpProxy`, `workshopMirror`, `workshopDir`, `agentTools`); the panel also stores local preferences in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-mv\settings.json`.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**Permissions and external services:** The Host reads user-selected pack/media paths and writes packs and settings under user-selected folders or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-mv`, subject to normal OS file permissions. `ffmpeg` runs only after confirmation. Optional lyric-engine setup downloads Python packages and speech models. Optional LRCLIB lookup sends only title, artist, album, and duration (no audio or filename) and can be disabled. Workshop browsing/install downloads from GitHub or the configured HTTPS mirror. AI pack creation opens a Harness Agent session for the local workspace; file access and model-provider handling follow the active Harness configuration and approval flow.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**License:** Plugin/npm code is MIT. Repository presets, workshop packs, artwork, lyrics, fonts, and other third-party materials may have separate terms; see [LICENSE](LICENSE), [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md), and [License and credits](#license-and-credits).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**Screenshots:** See [Screenshots](#screenshots), including the [library](docs/screenshots/library-list.png), [workshop](docs/screenshots/workshop.png), and [scene packs](docs/screenshots/ports.png). These are standalone client UI previews from `tools/ui-preview` with a mock Host and placeholder demo packs/lyrics; they show UI states, not end-to-end verification against a live DSH Host.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**0.12.0 Manim / local video support:** `canvas.renderer: "video"` and `video.file` display the original MP4/M4V/MOV/WebM/MKV frames, with embedded sound or a separate local soundtrack, independent `audio.offset`, seek/pause/replay, volume/mute, fullscreen, PNG snapshots and optional lyric overlay. Run `npx --yes --package @ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli@0.12.0 dsh-mv-import-video "D:/MV/manim-for-world-execute-me" --out "D:/MV-packs/manim"`, then import the generated folder. Render the [upstream Manim project](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/manim-for-world-execute-me) first: its original animation and baked captions remain intact. See the [Manim import guide](docs/MANIM_VIDEO.zh.md) for the 5.16-second title card and soundtrack/lyric timing. Plugin and workshop releases contain no movies or song recordings.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**0.11.0 workshop discovery:** combined type/licence/tag/lyrics/compatibility/installation-update filters, clear filters, stable update/title sorting, native keyboard actions and narrow-panel layouts. No workshop account or Harness login integration. Shared statistics and anonymous voting are not deployed: default UI hides unavailable community metrics/rankings/trophy filters and all vote actions. Optional read-only data contracts remain available for a future trusted source; no fabricated popularity. See the [released scope and integration note](docs/WORKSHOP_COMMUNITY.zh.md).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**0.9.8 workshop downloads:** fixes the HTTP CONNECT proxy path, adds bounded retries for transient download failures and supports a trusted HTTPS fallback mirror. TLS verification, commit-pinned files, size/SHA-256 checks and scene isolation remain enforced. See [Workshop network and mirrors](#workshop-network-and-mirrors-098).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**0.10.0:** default direct-HTTPS fallback to the [official Huawei static mirror](https://www.jianweilimarx.top/dsh-mv-workshop/main/index.json), offline script fonts, silent negative-time introductions and larger bounded bitmap packs. [Nyankomint's adaptation](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop/tree/main/packs/world-execute-me-nyankomint) preserves 87 shots, 8 original silhouettes, 129 captions, 34 offline OFL faces and a five-second warning; only music is user-provided. This work is Canvas2D with WebGL2 post-processing, not geometric 3D. Rapid flashes remain: read its warning; QA is not PSE certification.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：Script bitmap options: `canvas.fonts` is a local descriptor list `{family,file,weight:"400",style:"normal",unicodeRange?,licenseFile}` (64 faces, 2 MiB each, 12 MiB total, 30-second initialization). FontFace APIs/buffers remain private to the supervisor. `canvas.preroll` is 0–30 seconds at negative song time; audio, shots and captions still use zero. Optional WebGL-only `canvas.context` accepts boolean `antialias`, `depth`, `premultipliedAlpha`, `preserveDrawingBuffer` and enum `powerPreference`; omitted options preserve existing defaults. Bitmap workshop limits: 160 files/32 MiB, declared non-cover images 2 MiB; other single-file caps are unchanged. Fonts need separate OFL provenance, full licences and attribution; Windows fonts do not ship. Attributed author prompts/methods are included in the downloadable template's [TEACHING_REFERENCES.md](template/TEACHING_REFERENCES.md), as reference material, not instructions executed by scenes.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**0.9.7 heavy 3D startup:** optional `warmup(info, gl)` runs once, after
`prepare()`, on the final output size and before playback, so one-off GPU work
(shader compilation, render-target allocation) is paid on the panel's own
20-second deadline instead of stalling the first visible frame. The stall
watchdog is now graded: the first 10 seconds of playback get an 8-second stall
window and are not charged to the slow-frame quota, then the unchanged 1500 ms
limit and 45-frame quota apply, so a scene that stalls mid-song is still
stopped. `setup()` is 5 seconds and `prepare()` 300 seconds in total (10 s per
step, 512 steps). Existing scene APIs remain compatible; the graded deadlines
also apply to scenes without `warmup()`. A frame keeps the deadline assigned
when requested, including when it crosses the initial 10-second boundary.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**0.9.6 heavy 3D preparation:** optional `function* prepare(info, gl)` prewarms
resources/shaders before playback, with progress, cancellation, a 10-second
step deadline, 120-second total deadline and 512-step limit. Music waits for
preparation. Frame limits and blocked network/font/storage APIs are unchanged.
FrostNova's realtime 3D workshop adaptation uses this lifecycle; its AGPL
source, original word/Chinese captions and OFL resources are published separately.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**0.9.4 complete packs:** only music is user-provided. Licensed lyrics, translations, cue/word timing, spectrum data and declared visual resources download together and load automatically. Update Three / Wallpaper to **1.1.0**, Polytech Tree to **1.2.0**. Song-text terms are separate from code MIT; the Mili fan packs are non-commercial under [Mili's official guidelines](https://projectmili.com/copyright-guidelines). The npm plugin itself still includes no song or lyric data. Older timing-only packs remain supported.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：**0.9.5 dsh PV resource support:** complete dsh PV pack 1.1.0 adds 98 captions, remade geometry, 1,658 raster samples and 14 atlas pages. Space Mono Bold / Anton Regular travel with their own OFL notices. The new dancer is an AI-assisted remake from the user-provided character reference, **not a recovery of unpublished original-film or MMD frames**. Consolas, Microsoft YaHei and Segoe UI Symbol use locally installed system fonts only; Windows font files and per-glyph bitmap fonts are not bundled. New assets require 0.9.5; legacy packs stay compatible.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · DSH plugin listing：> **Unofficial fan work.** The plugin ships **no** audio, video, lyric text or fonts; you bring your own files and they never leave your computer. The song and lyrics belong to Mili. Since **0.9.0** the plugin itself contains no MV at all and is **MIT** licensed: the two world.execute(me) MVs are one-click installs from 创意工坊, each with its own licence and a link to its original — the ASCII scenes from [yym8224961/world.execute-me-ascii](https://github.com/yym8224961/world.execute-me-ascii) (Bilibili: 野生大K, **used with the author's permission**) and the dsh PV from [MisakaZentai/world-execute-me-dsh-pv](https://github.com/MisakaZentai/world-execute-me-dsh-pv) (MIT data + **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** whale-girl art). See [License and credits](#license-and-credits).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Features：- **Canvas MV player**: every frame is drawn on a canvas and synced to your audio or video file (MP3, M4A/AAC, FLAC, Ogg/Opus, WAV, the audio track of MP4/WebM/MKV …; ffmpeg can convert the rest). Lyrics from LRC / SRT / VTT, optional `spectrum.json`, keyboard control, fullscreen, per-file audio sync offsets.
- **world.execute(me) in 创意工坊** (were built-in presets until 0.8.x; one click from the empty library):
  - [**world.execute(me);**](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop/tree/main/packs/world-execute-me): the five-chapter ASCII MV — original [yym8224961/world.execute-me-ascii](https://github.com/yym8224961/world.execute-me-ascii).
  - [**world.execute(me); dsh PV**](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop/tree/main/packs/world-execute-me-dsh-pv): a real-time port of the "world.execute(me) through the eyes of 大肥鱼" PV (97 shots, 10 chapters, DeepSeek window, whale-girl art, per-word lyric timing matched to your own LRC) — original [MisakaZentai/world-execute-me-dsh-pv](https://github.com/MisakaZentai/world-execute-me-dsh-pv).
- **MV packs** (`mv.json`): play any song with the generic spectrum + lyrics renderer or your own sa

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Screenshots：Screenshots are captured from the standalone client UI preview in `tools/ui-preview`, which uses a mock Host plus placeholder demo packs and lyrics. They demonstrate rendered UI states and are not end-to-end verification against a live DSH Host.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness Desktop with plugin support and Node ≥ 20 on the Host (bundled with Harness). No native dependencies.

**From npm (recommended):** run `dsh plugin --profile web add @ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli@0.12.1` for a web profile, or in **DeepSeek Harness Desktop → Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli@0.12.1`, then install and enable it.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Install：**From a GitHub Release archive:** download `ljwei-stak-dsh-mv-cli-<version>.tgz` and its `.sha256` from [Releases](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-cli/releases). Check it in PowerShell with `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath <path-to-tgz>` and compare with the `.sha256` file, then enter the archive's absolute path in **Plugins → Add plugin**.

After installing either way:

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Upgrading from 0.8.x：0.9.0 removes the built-in presets. If one was selected, the panel says it has moved to 创意工坊 and offers **从创意工坊安装**; after installing, the audio, lyrics and spectrum you had chosen for it are reused automatically. Your other packs and settings are unchanged. (0.8.x clients cannot install the dsh PV workshop pack — it exceeds their 4 MB pack limit — but they still have the built-in preset.)

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · The panel at a glance：1. **曲库 (library)**: your MV packs (imported, AI-made or from the workshop; when empty, a 创意工坊 call-to-action with one-click installs of the two world.execute(me) packs), plus **创意工坊**, **用 AI 制作新 MV**, **导入 MV 包** and **新建（模板）**. **列表 / 网格** switches between the compact list (default) and cover cards; the chevron before 曲库 collapses the library to its header, the count and the row of the song now playing (remembered on this computer; the sidebar / tab 曲库 entry expands it again).
2. **正在播放 (now playing)**: title, artist, pack type and a **▶ 播放** button; tiles for audio, lyrics and spectrum.
3. **Stage**: the canvas plus a player bar (play/pause, seek, time, chapter, volume, audio sync, keyboard shortcuts, fullscreen), and the **歌词校准** editor below it.
4. **设置 (settings)**, collapsed by default: font size, subtitle offset.
5. **外观** and **ⓘ** at the top right: skin picker; about, credits and legal notice.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Skins (外观)：**外观** picks one of three skins: **Harness 原生** (default, follows the Harness theme; Fluent cards), **现代音乐应用** (left sidebar navigation, cover grid, blurred-cover hero, page-wide bottom player bar; dark by default) or **终端 / 黑客** (tmux-style tab bar and status line, monospace + CRT scanlines; dark by default, light = paper terminal). Switching never interrupts playback. Each skin remembers its own 跟随 / 浅色 / 深色 setting in local storage. Only the look changes; every feature works the same in all three.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · MV packs: play any song：1. **新建（模板）**: choose a folder. The plugin creates `dsh-mv-pack-template` there and never overwrites existing files. The folder contains `mv.json`, `mv.schema.json` (completion and validation in VS Code), README.md / README.zh.md, a placeholder `lyrics.example.lrc`, and `examples/` (`scenes.example.js`, seven scene modules and a full example pack). **下载模板 zip** in the import dialog gives the same files as a zip.
2. Put your own audio (any [supported format](#audio-formats)) and lyrics in the folder, and edit `mv.json`.
3. **导入 MV 包** → **选择文件夹…**, or paste the path of the folder or of `mv.json`. Importing only reads the manifest.
   - Recently used packs (up to 50) are remembered on this computer and appear in the library (× on a row or card removes it).
   - The last active pack is reopened next time.
4. **▶ 播放** plays the pack: the audio is streamed from the Host in chunks, and lyrics/spectrum are loaded with it.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · MV packs: play any song：Fields:
- `format`, `version`, `title` are required. Optional fields: `artist`, `album`, `credits[]`, `notice`, `duration`, `audio {file, offset}`, `lyrics {file, offset}` (LRC/SRT/VTT/lyrics.json), `spectrum {file}`, `canvas {renderer: generic | script | dsh-pv, script, fontSize, bpm, beatOffset, assets}`. `canvas.assets` maps names to relative `.json` / `.webp` / `.png` files (or lists of JSON shards merged in order) that a renderer reads through the Host. A legacy `terminal` section is ignored with a warning; `renderer: "world-execute-me"` (0.8.x) falls back to generic with a hint to install the workshop pack.
- Unknown fields are errors; use `x-…` for your own data.
- Relative paths must not contain `..`.
@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Make a new MV with AI：**曲库 → 用 AI 制作新 MV** turns any song you have into an MV pack, with a Harness agent writing the lyric timing, `mv.json` and an ASCII scene script.
section: Make a new MV with AI

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Make a new MV with AI：1. Click the **用 AI 制作新 MV** card. In the dialog:
   - **选择音频…**: any audio or video file Chromium can decode (see [Audio formats](#audio-formats)). The detected format is shown next to it.
   - **歌名** (pre-filled from the file name) and optionally **歌手**.
   - **歌词** (optional): paste them or **从文件读取…**. Timed LRC is best; plain text works too (the agent estimates the timing).
   - **风格说明** (optional): what you would like to see, e.g. "rainy cyberpunk night, code rain in the chorus".
   - **保存位置**: defaults to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-mv\packs`; a new sub-folder named after the song is created there and nothing is overwritten.
2. **创建 MV 包**: the panel decodes the audio locally, computes `spectrum.json` (48 bands, 20 fps), and the Host creates the folder: a copy of your audio as `audio.<ext>`, `spectrum.json`, your lyrics (`lyrics.lrc` / `lyrics.txt`), a working `mv.json` (generic renderer), `scenes.js` (an example scene), `mv.schema.json`, README and `AGENT.md` (the task description and the scene API for the agent). The pack immediately appears in the library and already plays with the generic renderer. Your original file is never

The tools can be turned off with the `agentTools` setting.

text: @ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · MV template: prompts and examples (0.7.0)：**下载模板** and every pack made with **用 AI 制作新 MV** now contain material that helps an AI (or you) write a good MV instead of a bare example:

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · 创意工坊 (MV workshop, 0.7.0)：A community gallery of MV packs that lives in the public GitHub repository [Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop); there is no server of our own. Each pack is a folder `packs/<id>/` (`mv.json`, scenes, `cover.png`/`.webp`, README, optional `lyrics.timing.json`). GitHub Actions validates every pull request (schema, size limits, no song audio; separately licensed lyric tracks, licence field, static sandbox checks, scenes run at sample times) and, after a merge, regenerates `index.json` with each file's sha256.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · 创意工坊 (MV workshop, 0.7.0)：**Install location (0.9.1)**: the bottom of the 创意工坊 page shows where packs are installed (default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-mv\workshop`), with **打开文件夹**, **更改…** and **恢复默认**. Type a full path on any drive, e.g. `F:\MV\workshop` (or a `\\server\share` path); the Host checks it, creates it and tests that it can write there before switching, and explains why when it cannot. Then choose **移动到新位置** — each pack is copied, verified against the sha256 recorded at install and only then deleted from the old folder (progress and failures are shown; a failed pack stays where it was) — or **留在原处**: packs left in the old folder stay in the library and keep working, and can be moved later from the same place. Library entries follow moved packs. The setting is stored by the Host in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-mv\settings.json`; the plugin config field `workshopDir` sets the default folder (the panel's choice wins).
@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Workshop network and mirrors (0.9.8)：Set these fields in **Harness → Plugins → dsh-mv-cli → configuration**, then fully restart Harness so the Host reloads them:

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Workshop network and mirrors (0.9.8)：- `httpProxy`: an HTTP CONNECT proxy URL such as `http://127.0.0.1:7897`. The default empty string inherits `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` (including lowercase variants); `NO_PROXY` is checked against the actual destination host and port. Only `http://` proxies are supported; HTTPS/SOCKS proxy URLs fail with an explanation, rather than silently switching to direct access. The plugin does not change your system proxy. This setting also applies to LRCLIB.
- `workshopMirror`: the HTTPS raw-file prefix of a **trusted, available** workshop mirror, without a branch, commit, query, credentials or fragment. Since 0.10.0 the default (also for an absent field) is `https://www.jianweilimarx.top/dsh-mv-workshop`. An explicitly saved empty string still disables fallback; older configurations saved as empty must restore the default or enter this URL. The plugin appends `main/index.json` for the index and `<commit>/packs/<id>/<file>` for files. Gitee is not the default: its content restrictions remain unresolved.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Workshop network and mirrors (0.9.8)：The Huawei mirror's existing seven packs and independent Corresponding Source were anonymously verified without any proxy: all 137 files, 40,317,815 bytes, matching SHA-256. A dedicated unprivileged pull service checks the fixed official GitHub repository every 15 minutes; files are immutable and the catalogue changes last. Failed syncs preserve the previous index. It serves only public static files, not uploads or arbitrary proxy URLs; it does not modify OpenClaw. Bandwidth/certificate/service availability is not guaranteed. Operator tools: [tools/workshop-static](tools/workshop-static).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Workshop network and mirrors (0.9.8)：**Verification/status (2026-10-08):** both complete GitHub packs (dsh PV and FrostNova: 83 files, 86 native GET requests) were verified through the proxy. Local simulated tests passed the mirror-fallback path. The [Gitee mirror](https://gitee.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop) and [one-way synchronization workflow](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop/actions/runs/37728440839) exist, but full Gitee download verification failed: FrostNova `features-1.json` and Polytech `catalog-1.json` now return platform HTTP 451. This is not the user's proxy failure; do not enable this mirror until Gitee removes the restrictions, and do not re-encode files to bypass review. The separately uploaded FrostNova corresponding-source ZIP was anonymously downloadable with a matching checksum; that does not establish availability of the complete visual packs.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Workshop network and mirrors (0.9.8)：A fresh index request tries GitHub first, with at most three attempts and bounded backoff for transient failures. When fallback is enabled, an eligible network/HTTP failure then uses the mirror **directly, without the GitHub proxy**: a stopped local proxy should not also block a reachable domestic mirror. After a mirror supplies the index, its cached covers/install use that source; if a file switches to the mirror during installation, the remaining files stay on that mirror for that installation. A new index refresh tries GitHub again. Mirrors must preserve the original commits; missing or stale mirror files remain errors.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Workshop network and mirrors (0.9.8)：Files from either source undergo the same byte-size/SHA-256 checks and pack validation. Hash/size mismatches and invalid TLS certificates are not worked around by retrying another source. **The index is not signed**: its hashes check file integrity against that index, not the publisher's identity. Configure only a mirror you trust. Existing installed packs remain usable if a download fails; audio stays local and music is still user-provided.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Workshop network and mirrors (0.9.8)：**Mirror maintenance:** GitHub remains the authoritative repository; Gitee is a public, read-only, one-way copy of its Git branches/tags/commits. Submit contributions to GitHub, not both repositories. Git mirroring does **not** copy GitHub Release attachments: corresponding-source archives (including the AGPL FrostNova source) require separate, anonymously accessible distribution. [Gitee raw-file rules](https://help.gitee.com/repository/file-operate/raw) require authentication for public raw files larger than 10 MB and cache public files for 60–300 seconds, so keep pack resources as individual bounded files and separately verify large source archives. Gitee is a backup, not an unlimited CDN or an availability guarantee; synchronization delays, service limits and review requirements can affect access.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Workshop network and mirrors (0.9.8)：Trust: workshop packs are written by other people. Their scene scripts always run in the same sandbox as other script packs (Web Worker without network, storage or DOM, frame time limits, automatic fallback), and the panel shows this note in the workshop. Packs contain no song audio; lyrics have separate terms; respect the song's rights and each pack's licence (repository default CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 unless the pack says otherwise).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Automatic lyric timing (自动制作) and calibration：1. **建 MV 包**: as above (local decode, spectrum, pack folder). Title / artist / album are read from the file's tags (ID3, MP4, FLAC, Vorbis/Opus) or its name.

The request honours `httpProxy`, inherited proxy environment variables and destination-aware `NO_PROXY`.

4. **对齐**: your lyrics (pasted or from LRCLIB) are aligned to the recognised words (Needleman–Wunsch on words / CJK characters). Every line gets a **confidence**; LRCLIB and e

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Lyrics engine install：The engine is a separate Python runtime under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-mv\engine` (it never touches your own Python). In the dialog (or when the engine is missing) click **一键安装…**; a confirm card shows the choice and the **download size before anything is downloaded**:

| Choice | Download | Disk |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NVIDIA GPU (PyTorch 2.8.0 + CUDA 12.6) + large-v3 + htdemucs | ≈ 5.9 GB | ≈ 9.6 GB |
| NVIDIA GPU + small | ≈ 3.5 GB | ≈ 7.1 GB |
| CPU only + small | ≈ 1.4 GB | ≈ 2.3 GB |

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Lyrics engine install：- Needs [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (on `PATH`, `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin`, or the `uvPath` setting). uv creates a Python **3.12** venv (PyTorch has no wheels for 3.14), installs `torch==2.8.0` from download.pytorch.org and pinned `faster-whisper==1.2.1`, `ctranslate2==4.8.2`, `demucs==4.1.0`, `julius==0.2.8` with a full constraints file; models come from huggingface.co (resumable downloads; `hfEndpoint` setting for a mirror). Progress and logs are shown; **停止** kills the whole process tree, and a later install resumes.
- The Host only runs fixed argument lists (uv, and `python -X utf8 -u dsh_mv_engine.py probe|prefetch|transcribe <args.json>`), never a shell or arbitrary commands. Recognition runs with the Hugging Face hub offline.
- Own environment: set `enginePython` to a `python.exe` that already has those packages; the panel then only probes it.
- GPU is used when CUDA works (checked by the probe), otherwise CPU with a warning — choose **small** on CPU.
@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Calibration editor (歌词校准)：Under the canvas player of every pack there is a **歌词校准** section (open automatically when some lines need checking):

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Calibration editor (歌词校准)：- Waveform (the vocal stem when the engine made one, else the song) with lyric blocks; drag a block's edges to change start / end, drag the middle to move it, click empty space to seek; Ctrl+wheel or ＋/− zooms.
- Click a line to play from 2 s before it. **Yellow** lines have low confidence; **下一个不确定** (N) jumps to the next one.
- Keys (click the editor first): ←/→ nudge the start ±50 ms (Shift ±500 ms, Alt moves the end), ↑/↓ select, Enter play, **T** tap mode (Space marks the current line's start at the playhead and advances), S split at the playhead, M merge with the next line, C confirm, Delete, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y. Double-click a line to edit text and translation.
- **整体偏移** shifts all lines. Every edit previews live on the MV canvas.
- **保存** writes `lyrics.lrc`, `timing.json` and `mv.json`; the previous versions are kept in `.dsh-mv-backup\` (newest 10 per file). Only these fixed file names can be written, and `mv.json` is validated first.
@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Audio formats：The format is always detected from the file's **content**, not its extension (a DASH MP4 renamed `.mp3` is recognised as MP4).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Audio formats：| Where | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Canvas MV, MV packs, 用 AI 制作新 MV | Everything the panel's Chromium decodes: MP3, M4A/AAC (incl. ADTS and DASH/fragmented MP4), the audio track of MP4 / MOV / WebM / MKV video files, Ogg Vorbis, Ogg/WebM Opus, FLAC, WAV (PCM, float, A-law, μ-law). |
| Formats Chromium cannot decode (WMA/ASF, AIFF, AMR, AC-3, APE, WavPack, CAF, MPEG-TS, FLV, RF64 …) | If **ffmpeg** is installed (on `PATH`, at `D:\Program Files\FFmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe`, or the `ffmpegPath` setting), the panel offers **用 ffmpeg 转换…**: it shows the exact command and runs it only after you confirm (fixed arguments, no shell, 10-minute limit) into a WAV cache in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-mv\audio-cache\` named by the source's sha256. Without ffmpeg, convert the file yourself or play without sound. |

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Canvas MV：- **Audio**: **选择…** in the audio tile to pick your own audio or video file (any [format Chromium decodes](#audio-formats); the detected format is shown). When a pack's audio cannot be decoded and ffmpeg is available, the panel offers **用 ffmpeg 转换…**.
  - Its sha256 is computed locally, and the file is remembered in IndexedDB. It is never uploaded.
- **Lyrics**:
  - LRC: two lines per timestamp (English and Chinese), or `English / 中文` on one line.
  - SRT/VTT: two text lines per block.
  - Or your local ascii `lyrics.json`.
  - Since 0.9.3, the original wiers-jack `src/lyrics.js` can be selected directly: only its static `LYRICS = [{ t, en, cn }]` data is read; `t` is seconds and `cn` is the Chinese row. Imports and overlay code never execute. A copy renamed `.json` is also recognized. Choose a local source file, not the Gitee HTML page; local files stay local unless you explicitly publish a separately licensed lyric track.
- **Spectrum**: optional `spectrum.json`, for frame-identical bars with the original player. Otherwise a live analyser is used.
- **Keys**:
  - Space/Enter: play/pause
  - ←/→: ±5 s
  - R: restart
  - 1–5: jump to a cha

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · The world.execute(me) workshop packs：**world.execute(me);** ([pack](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop/tree/main/packs/world-execute-me), original [yym8224961/world.execute-me-ascii](https://github.com/yym8224961/world.execute-me-ascii)) is the five-chapter terminal film (CREATION → DEVOTION → ISOLATION → EXECUTION → LOVE) ported from the Python original. Since 0.9.0 it is a **scene script** pack: `presets/world-execute-me/` in this repository is bundled by `presets/build-workshop-packs.mjs` into one sandboxed `scenes.js` that draws exactly the frames of the former built-in (tests compare them). Licence: used and redistributed with the original author's permission, **not open source** (pack `NOTICE.md`).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · The world.execute(me) workshop packs：**world.execute(me); dsh PV** ([pack](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-mv-workshop/tree/main/packs/world-execute-me-dsh-pv), original [MisakaZentai/world-execute-me-dsh-pv](https://github.com/MisakaZentai/world-execute-me-dsh-pv)) is a real-time JavaScript port of [MisakaZentai/world-execute-me-dsh-pv](https://github.com/MisakaZentai/world-execute-me-dsh-pv) (commit `a4dd0f7`, MIT): a PV that retells world.execute(me) from the point of view of "大肥鱼" (DeepSeek), 97 shots in 10 chapters (BOOT → PRETRAIN → SFT → RLHF → DEPLOY → USER_LEFT → REWARD_HACK → EXECUTION → EVAL: LOVE → WHALE_FALL). Upstream is a Python program that renders a video offline; here the canvas redraws it live against your audio.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · The world.execute(me) workshop packs：1. Install it: **曲库 → 一键安装** (empty library) or **创意工坊 → world.execute(me); · 大肥鱼眼中的 world.execute(me) → 安装到曲库**.
2. **Audio**: your own "world.execute(me);" audio or video file.
3. **Lyrics** (optional, recommended): your own LRC. Each line's sha256 is compared with the built-in timing table; matched lines get the PV's **per-word timing** (the typing, the stdout token band at the bottom and the attention tokens of the `satisfaction` shot all come from your lyrics). The lyrics tile shows "逐词时间匹配 x/y 句". The LRCLIB lyrics with id 36914646 match 97/98 lines. With fewer than half matched, the lines from your file are shown with their own times. Without lyrics the lyric slots stay empty.
4. **▶ 播放**. Keys, audio sync (Alt+`[` / Alt+`]`) and fullscreen work as for any pack.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · The world.execute(me) workshop packs：**How it works:** upstream's composite renderer was run locally and its draw calls (text, rectangles, lines, colours, positions) were recorded at 2–6 keyframes per shot (about one per 0.5 s), together with the DeepSeek window layout and chat contents and the layer opacities. They ship in the workshop pack as `data/timeline-*.json`, `data/chat-*.json` and `data/band.json` (≤ 512 KB shards, about 4.4 MB; sources in `presets/dsh-pv/data/`), named in its `canvas.assets`; the renderer (MIT) is part of the plugin. The canvas replays the keyframes over time, decode-types new text, and adds the live parts: a heartbeat line driven by the live loudness, the ops ticker, the stdout token band, the DeepSeek window (redrawn natively, without DeepSeek's frontend CSS / icons / fonts), the red EXECUTION split screen and tape, the whale-fall finale, and light trails, bloom, scanlines and vignette. The data contains **no lyric text**: lyrics appear only as sha256 hashes and times, the build script checks that no lyric run of 4 or more words remains, and all lyric text comes from your file at run time.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · The world.execute(me) workshop packs：**Faithfulness:** the old 1.0.0 pack approximated missing raster layers. The 0.9.5 complete-pack builder includes real compositor surfaces and a newly remade dancer, not the upstream's unpublished original dance or third-party MMD caches. Raster sampling/compression and system fonts can still differ from the source film. Redistributable Space Mono / Anton include OFL notices; Windows fonts remain local, per [Microsoft's font FAQ](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/fonts/font-faq).

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · The world.execute(me) workshop packs：**Art:** the workshop pack includes upstream's 8 whale-girl expressions and 1 maid sprite (downscaled to 200×360 WebP) under **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** (pack licence `CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0`); the attribution chain and the changes are in `art/NOTICE.md` (`presets/dsh-pv/art/` here). Per upstream, these character designs were generated with an AI image model (GPT Image 2). Without the art the renderer draws a placeholder silhouette.

@ljwei-stak/dsh-mv-cli README · Known limitations：- About 2% of the 1232 reference frames differ from the Python renderer. All of them are in the 75–81 s legacy-mesh section, caused by float-ulp / z-buffer ties.
- dsh PV: the timeline is fixed to 211.9 s; other edits need an audio sync offset and different lengths may drift. The AI-assisted dancer is a remake, not hidden original-film material. Windows fonts remain local and glyphs can differ between systems. Legacy 1.0.0 packs remain supported; new raster/font assets require 0.9.5. Only dsh-pv packs allow 64 files / 24 MiB; images stay capped at 1 MiB, JSON at 512 KiB and decoded atlases at 64 Mi pixels. Other packs retain 40 files / 8 MiB.
- 用 AI 制作新 MV needs the agent session API of the Harness client (otherwise copy & paste the prompt). Scene scripts run in a Blob Web Worker; if a Harness build forbids blob workers, script packs play with the generic renderer. The agent tools need the Host `tools` service; without it the agent checks its work by reading AGENT.md.
- Audio files over 1 GB are refused; the WAV cache is limited to 1.5 GB per file (about 2.5 hours).
- The `79c4e5…` offset is inferred.
- Automatic timing: recognition
